Implement task U9 from tasks.toml: Display-timezone setting

timefmt currently uses the server’s local zone for both parsing datetime-local input and rendering. Make the zone explicit and configurable so a phone in another timezone cannot silently shift timestamps.

Notes recorded on this task in tasks.toml -- read these first: they may be feedback from a prior review that this run must address, not just background context.
  touches corrected 2026-08-04: amendment U2 moved timefmt from routers to models, so the path recorded here no longer existed. Note the zone is also read by series_service (local-day bucketing) and by the ribbon view, so a config-driven zone must reach the service layer, not only the templates.

Exit criteria (every one must pass before you stop):
  - configured zone used for parse+render (test)
  - DST boundary case tested

Constraints:
  - Touch only these paths: src/cradle/models/timefmt.py, rules_config.toml, src/cradle/routers/templates/settings.html
  - Work on branch task/U9-displaytimezone-setting; create it from the current HEAD if absent.
  - Verify with: ./scripts/test
  - Then run: python3 scripts/backlog.py  (must exit 0)
  - When the exit criteria pass, set the status of this task to review in tasks.toml. Never set it to done -- only CI and a human reviewer do that.
  - Follow CLAUDE.md. Minimal diffs, no speculative refactors, no changes outside the paths above.
